issues.reason: *Names and casing* requires the entity's kind in one ordinary type atom "whether the kind word sits inside the name or beside it" - its own "the Kestrel River" -> (Member kestrel_river river) example - and *Core patterns* names "a kind word inside the name itself" as a licensing source, so the missing (Member lantern_night night) leaves a named referent typed nowhere.

new_gaps: A NAMED TIME whose name carries its kind word ("Lantern-night", "Midsummer Eve") falls between two sections that do not meet: *Time* says a named time "stays a bare symbol" on Time and bars Member atoms for deictic times, while *Names and casing* mandates the type atom for a name carrying its kind word. The kind word here (night) is additionally a reserved day-part constant on Time, so the type atom overloads that symbol - a licensed form would need to state whether a Time-filler name is typed at all and, if so, which symbol carries the day-part sense.
defect_summary: The compliant form adds (Member lantern_night night) (STV 1.0 0.99) beside the existing Name atom; the rest of the parse stands.
notes: The rest is doctrinal: group witness for the definite plural, group event plus the per-member distribution rule for the distributive predicate, the bare kind filler for the non-specific plural object, the compound's head genus with the noun modifier unexposed, and no status atom on the habitual present.
